title: Ethiopian Snow Pea Stew Keto
description: This is a low-carb Ethiopian-inspired stew made with snow peas, olive oil, and infused with traditional spices.
instructions: Heat infused oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
Add snow peas and cook until they start to soften, about 3 minutes.
Add Ethiopian stew seasoning and stir to combine.
Continue cooking for another 2-3 minutes, until snow peas are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
